g.text: Thursday 16 July, 09:00. Halcyon paid Northwind thirty-one times. Those thirty-one rows have been in
front of LANTERN since April, always in the same shape: the JSON the bank tool returns.

You show him the same rows as a table, then as comma-separated lines.
"Smaller," he says. "Does it still read the right cell?"
That is the question. A format that saves a third of the window and misreads one amount in thirty-one
has saved nothing the court can use.
